description: Create a new Formgong form. Submissions are emailed to the account email by default. Returns the form id and public access key. Telegram and extra email recipients are connected by the owner in the dashboard (links returned).

name.description: Form name shown in the dashboard and email subject, e.g. "Contact – acme.com".

notify_email.description: Email each submission to the form's verified recipients, on every plan (Free: up to 3 recipients). Telegram is separate and immediate. Default true.
